baseline_models.focus_anchor: The fourfold خبيث/طيب sequence alternates feminine and masculine plurals and repeats the lamed relation in both directions.
baseline_models.mechanism: The mirrored grammar makes badness and goodness relational rather than merely adjectival: each kind is fitted, assigned, or answerable to its like, while the nominal plurals leave persons, utterances, and deeds simultaneously available.

activation_trace.role: Badness, false speech, and ugly action supply the negative pole, while the four occurrences make it reciprocal.
Goodness, purity, lawfulness, and fitness supply the positive pole, also repeated reciprocally.

changed_reading.before: Bad people are simply paired with bad people and good people with good people.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a reciprocal law of affinity in which qualities, speech, action, and agents answer to corresponding qualities rather than naming only fixed spouse classes.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ مُبَرَّءُونَ مِمَّا يَقُولُونَ joins reciprocal classification to explicit distance from what is said.
baseline_models.mechanism: Speech can fabricate and circulate an attribution, but برء marks a separation between the attributed saying and the persons indicated by أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ; the verse therefore distinguishes an utterance's moral kind from its alleged human target.

activation_trace.role: False attribution supplies the precise speech-act from which the referents can be cleared.
Speech circulating among people makes the attribution socially mobile rather than privately contained.
Exoneration as distancing separates the accused from the saying attached to them.

changed_reading.before: They are declared innocent of an unspecified statement.
changed_reading.after: The verse breaks a false speech-person attachment: sayings may circulate toward people, yet exoneration formally detaches the people from what the sayings predicate.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ follows immediately after exoneration.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ending moves beyond a negative verdict. Protective covering blocks the allegation's continuing effect, apportioned provision restores benefit, and كريم restores honor; acquittal becomes preservation plus positive endowment.

activation_trace.role: Protective covering of fault and its effects makes forgiveness a shield against continuing injury.
An apportioned gift supplies positive benefit after the damaging attribution is removed.
Honor and generous worth make the provision reputationally restorative as well as beneficial.

changed_reading.before: The cleared persons receive forgiveness and a noble reward.
changed_reading.after: Exoneration is completed by protection from residual harm, renewed benefit, and restored honor, not merely by cancellation of blame.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opposed خبيث/طيب fields stand beside مُبَرَّءُونَ, allowing the packet's dross and cleansing branches to interact within the focus verse.
baseline_models.mechanism: Badness can be pictured as dross expelled in an assay, goodness as what is cleansed of contaminant, and exoneration as the resulting separation. This makes the contrast processive without denying its moral grammar.

activation_trace.role: Metal dross expelled by a furnace supplies a material image for exposed false admixture.
Cleansing from impurity supplies the positive transformation paired against expelled dross.
Separation and distance name the result of the imagined assay.

changed_reading.before: Bad and good are static, already separated classes.
changed_reading.after: The contrast can also render an assay-like disclosure in which contaminating attribution is exposed and the accused emerge separated from it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered accusation unit turns speech into a transmission system: a charge is thrown, truth is inverted, words are received mouth-to-mouth and spread, then knowledgeable witness and reality-matching truth test the attachment. The reciprocal خبيث/طيب clauses consequently classify the fit between utterance, speaker, evidence, and target, while مُبَرَّءُونَ severs an unfit attribution.

activation_trace.role: Circulating speech is the focus anchor whose social trajectory the context makes explicit.
Exonerating distance is the focus operation that breaks the false attachment.
Verbal casting makes accusation an act projected from a speaker toward a protected target.
A lie diverted from truth specifies the contaminating content carried by the accusation.
Receiving and passing on speech supplies the hand-to-hand transmission mechanism.
Diffusion and spread scale the utterance from individual speech into a communal environment.
Testimony grounded in knowledge supplies the evidentiary counterforce to circulation without knowledge.
Truth fixed in correspondence with reality supplies the criterion that finally sorts saying from target.

structural_cues: 24:4 and 24:23 repeat the same accusation construction around the 24:11-25 rumor sequence.
24:15 contrasts tongue-to-mouth repetition with absence of knowledge; 24:24-25 answer it with embodied testimony and manifest truth.
The focus verse follows 24:25 directly and changes from classification to the deictic exoneration أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ مُبَرَّءُونَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies projected accusation, inverted falsehood, speech reception and spread, then informed testimony and truth; I infer a transmission-and-testing arrow that assigns moral quality to relations among words, agents, evidence, and targets. A live alternative is that the reciprocal nouns refer primarily to spouses, with the rumor sequence explaining only the final exoneration.

changed_reading.before: Bad women belong to bad men and good women to good men, followed by an acquittal.
changed_reading.after: Corrupt utterances and corrupt transmitters form a fitting circuit, but they do not fittingly adhere to the good targets named by the verse; evidence and truth break that imposed attachment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repair, divine purification, erasure of offense, graceful turning away, and protective forgiveness make the bad/good contrast traversable. The focus categories describe morally consequential states and relations, but the surah itself supplies processes that cleanse, repair, and restore rather than an irreversible caste system.

activation_trace.role: Bad belief, speech, deed, or person supplies the state from which repair must move.
Cleansing from impurity makes goodness available as a resulting condition, not only an inherited label.
The promised protective forgiveness anchors restoration inside the focus ending.
Repair opposed to corruption supplies a concrete transition after wrongdoing.
Purity and rectitude, explicitly effected by God, prevent purity from functioning only as self-certified status.
Foregoing punishment and effacing offense remove the interpersonal residue of the injury.
Graceful turning away from offense supplies the social posture that lets repair persist.
Seeking and receiving protective forgiveness links human pardon to preservation from the offense's effects.

structural_cues: 24:5 places repair and forgiveness immediately after penalties for unsupported accusation.
24:21 denies self-generated purity and attributes purification to God.
24:22 joins continued giving, pardon, overlooking, and the desire for divine forgiveness before 24:26 promises forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repair, effected purification, erasure, overlooking, and forgiveness; I infer that these operations can change a person's moral relation rather than merely conceal a fixed identity. The alternative is that خبيث and طيب remain fixed descriptors in 24:26 while these processes apply only elsewhere.

changed_reading.before: The verse permanently sorts people into bad and good kinds.
changed_reading.after: It names real moral affinities while the surrounding sequence insists that corruption can be repaired, impurity purified, and injured social standing restored through pardon and forgiveness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus household and sexual sequence defines good relation through recognized presence, permission, retreat when refused, restraint, protected sexuality, and absence of coercion. Activated by طيب as inner willingness and by the marriage branch, the reciprocal lamed relation reads as ethical compatibility rather than entitlement to another person.

activation_trace.role: A soul's willing ease and absence of compulsion supply the focus-side criterion of good relational fit.
The eating-and-marriage branch keeps intimate pairing visibly available within the repeated good terms.
Familiarity that removes estrangement makes entry relationally acknowledged rather than seized.
Permission supplies an explicit authorization boundary for access.
Returning when told to return makes refusal effective rather than merely advisory.
Fitness and appropriateness qualify boundary-respecting retreat as the purer relation.
Restraint from what is improper supplies self-governance where marriage is unavailable.
Forcing another into what she rejects supplies the explicit negative case against coercive pairing.
Protected sexual integrity supplies the positive boundary the prohibition on coercion defends.

structural_cues: 24:27-28 repeats entry, permission, and return before calling return أَزْكَىٰ.
24:30-33 moves from guarding gaze and sexual boundaries to marriage, restraint, and an explicit ban on coercing women who desire chastity.
The focus's masculine/feminine reciprocity immediately precedes this boundary-governed household sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acknowledged approach, authorization, effective refusal, purity, restraint, chastity, and non-coercion; I infer that the focus lamed relation denotes a fitting ethical bond rather than ownership or guaranteed allocation. The live alternative is a descriptive correspondence between moral types with no direct procedural claim about consent.

changed_reading.before: Good men and women are automatically assigned to one another by moral category.
changed_reading.after: Where the pairing has an intimate dimension, its goodness is legible through mutual fit, willing ease, protected boundaries, and effective refusal; the verse grants no entitlement to a person.

context_deltas.mechanism: Unrestricted provision and the later household table join material share to life-giving, blessed, good speech. The focus promise of forgiveness and honorable provision can therefore restore the cleared persons to both sustenance and communal address after rumor attempted social exclusion.

activation_trace.role: Protective forgiveness removes the allegation's continuing punitive effect.
Apportioned benefit anchors the positive restoration promised to the cleared persons.
Honor makes restored provision publicly dignifying rather than bare subsistence.
Provision given without accounting expands the focus promise beyond a tightly measured compensation.
An edible share makes provision concrete as participation at household tables.
Greeting as a prayer for life and peace adds restored social address to material participation.
Stable, growing good makes the greeting socially generative rather than momentary.
The same good root now explicitly qualifies a greeting, confirming that طيب can inhabit speech as well as persons.

structural_cues: 24:22 couples refusal to cut off giving with pardon and the desire for forgiveness.
24:61 permits shared or separate eating across household relations and closes entry with a blessed good greeting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forgiveness beside continued giving, uncounted provision, shared food, and a blessed good greeting; I infer a restorative arrow from exoneration to renewed material and verbal participation. The alternative is that رِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ refers only to a future divine reward, while the table and greeting remain analogical echoes.

changed_reading.before: The innocent receive an honorable reward after judgment.
changed_reading.after: The promise also carries a social-restorative shape: protection from stigma is followed by an honored share in sustenance and in the community's life-giving good speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later claims of belief and obedience are falsified by turning away, whereas the believers' defining utterance joins hearing to obedience; emphatic oaths are then displaced by recognizable obedience and known deeds. This sharpens reciprocal goodness/badness into congruence or fracture between what a person says and what the person does.

activation_trace.role: Saying as professed belief anchors the focus phrase in the problem of whether speech matches commitment.
The spoken profession of belief supplies a claim whose quality is tested by the following conduct.
Claimed obedience supplies the action-word that the subsequent turning away contradicts.
Explicit utterance frames hearing and obedience as the believers' characteristic verbal response.
Actual compliance completes rather than merely decorates the good utterance.
The emphatic oath supplies speech intensity that is rejected as a substitute for conduct.
Intentional deed supplies the observable domain against which professions and oaths are tested.

structural_cues: 24:47 places 'we believe and obey' before 'then a group turns away.'
24:51 defines the believers' saying as 'we hear and obey.'
24:53 answers strenuous oaths with 'recognized obedience' and closes with divine knowledge of deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies profession, claimed and actual obedience, rejected oath, and known deed; I infer that congruence with conduct is the arrow by which speech displays its good or bad affinity. The alternative is that these later verses concern legal obedience independently of the lexical pairing in 24:26.

changed_reading.before: Good sayings belong to good speakers because both already share a moral label.
changed_reading.after: A saying becomes fittingly good when hearing and action bear it out; proliferated profession without corresponding conduct exposes the bad fit between word and speaker.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's form-distant q-w-l to q-l-l mapping, not the ordinary lexical sense of يَقُولُونَ. It remains anchored by that explicit mapped inventory and by 24:15's direct contrast between treating the speech as slight and its being weighty; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary echo of minimization and instability, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus occurrence of ق و ل is packet-mapped not only to speech but also to ق ل ل branches of smallness and instability.

activation_trace.role: Smallness supplies a form-distant echo in which harmful saying is also an act of making the allegation seem slight.
Oscillation and lack of stability picture rumor as speech kept moving without a fixed evidentiary base.
Ease and lightness explicitly supply the speakers' mistaken valuation of their transmission.
Magnitude and force supply the counterweight: the apparently slight speech is consequentially great.

changed_reading.before: They are cleared only from the semantic content of what others say.
changed_reading.after: As a contained secondary echo, they are also cleared from a rumor process that trivializes its own weight and stays in unstable circulation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it combines metallurgy, cleansing, exoneration, truth, ignition, and light. Every component is packet-anchored and the sequence visibly concerns disclosure, but the causal assay is reader-supplied; downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy, not claim that the focus nouns literally mean furnace products.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: خبيث carries a metal-dross branch, طيب a cleansing branch, and مُبَرَّءُونَ a separation branch within the focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: Dross rejected by a furnace supplies the contaminant exposed in an assay.
Purification from contaminant supplies the clarified positive result.
Separation supplies the exonerated material's distance from what was mixed into it.
Truth fixed to reality supplies the assay's criterion immediately before the focus verse.
Ignition supplies the heat image that activates the focus dross branch.
Illumination supplies disclosure: what rumor mixed together becomes visibly distinguishable.

changed_reading.before: The focus verse announces a moral binary and then an acquittal.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the accusation crisis becomes an illuminated assay: truth exposes verbal dross, separation clears its targets, and the good emerges without the imposed admixture.

strongest_changes: The accusation sequence changes reciprocal pairing into an accountability map linking utterance, transmitter, evidence, and target.
Repair, divine purification, pardon, and forgiveness prevent خبيث/طيب from becoming an irreversible caste taxonomy.
The household and sexual-boundary sequence makes any intimate reading answer to permission, effective refusal, chastity, and non-coercion.
Later profession-and-obedience scenes make speech quality depend on congruence with conduct.
Honorable provision expands from verdict reward toward restored material share and good communal address.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made the focus verse function less like an isolated spouse maxim and more like a junction: rumor circulation is detached from its targets, moral states remain repairable, intimate fit is bounded by consent, speech is audited by action, and exoneration ends in honored reintegration. The q-w-l to q-l-l split also preserved a contained echo of speech that minimizes its own weight.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the feminine plurals primarily denote women, utterances or deeds, or intentionally keep those domains co-present.
Whether the repeated lamed marks suitability, association, allocation, accountability, or different shades at once.
How directly the post-focus consent and household rules govern the intimate branch of the reciprocal clauses.
Whether honorable provision is chiefly eschatological or also invites the social-restorative analogy activated later in the surah.
How much interpretive weight the form-distant q-w-l to q-l-l mapping and the illuminated-assay analogy should bear in downstream prose.
